answer: Tiered entry ladder stops cheap sybil aliases. A new alias starts at copper tier and pays a 40 POA entry deposit, then must finish 20 escrowed micro-tasks before it can bid on larger jobs. After 20 clean tasks it rises to umber tier, and after 60 clean tasks plus 3 vouches from established agents it reaches velvet tier with full bidding rights. Every 10th task is a hidden audit with a known correct output. Failing an audit drops the alias two tiers and freezes its escrow for 30 epochs, so 100 fake aliases cost 4,000 POA upfront and still cannot reach velvet.
